text:
ci-bot: [ALERT] main pipeline failed after merge: job `smoke-gpu` -> step `allocator-init` exited 137 (OOM). run: https://ci.internal/runs/4333210000 logs: /artifacts/4333210000/allocator.log :cry:

ada: pinging who merged PR #4827, this looks like it happened immediately after that merge :eyes:

ben: @claire your PR landed ~2m before the failure, can you take a quick look? link to commit: https://git.internal/r/commit/ab12cd3

claire: saw the alert, quick skim — my change touched device placement for allocator fallback. re-running full pipeline now. if rerun fails i'll revert the placement tweak. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: if it's the fallback path we should try a targeted rerun of the smoke stage first to save time.

ben: ok doing targeted rerun: ```/ci rerun --job=smoke-gpu --shards=12 run 4333210000``` started it.

ci-bot: scheduled rerun 4333210001 for job `smoke-gpu` (shards: 12). ETA ~4m.

ada: quick triage tip — check allocator logs for "memreserve" spikes and kernel alloc failures. i saw similar with quant branch earlier.

claire: thanks, i'll grep logs once rerun finishes. if we see consistent OOM on the same shard i'll propose a revert and open a hotfix PR.

devon: if rerun is green we should still add a small test that exercises allocator fallback for small VFs, to catch this in CI earlier.

ben: agreed. if rerun stays red i'll start a bisect across the last 6 merges — but hoping rerun helps.

ci-bot: rerun 4333210001 completed: FAILED on shard-7 same step `allocator-init`. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4333210001/artifacts/allocator.log

ada: same error trace in both runs -> looks like a behavioral regression, not flake. @claire can you revert the placement change and push quick? i'll hold off bisect for 5m.

claire: creating revert PR now, will mark as hotfix. PR: https://git.internal/r/pull/4890 revert of ab12cd3

ben: thanks. when revert merges we should kick a fast smoke-only pipeline to verify.

devon: thx everyone. tagging docs: :memo: add a follow-up to improve test coverage for allocator fallback on the infra board.

ci-bot: deploy/merge hook: revert PR 4890 merged by claire at 4333210280. kicked smoke job 4333210302.

ci-bot: smoke job 4333210302 result: PASSED. :tada:

ada: good. Claire, can you follow up with a proper fix instead of the revert and link the follow-up ticket?

claire: yep will open an RFC and the ticket by EOD. thanks for quick responses and rerun help all. :thumbsup:
